headline: Nifty 50 above 25,000, holds key moving averages: Is Buy-On-Dips right strategy? Here's what stock market experts say | Stock Market News
summary: Indian markets fell on Friday after retail inflation rose to 6.09%, above the RBI's tolerance limit. Analysts said the broader technical outlook remains positive, citing support at 24,850 to 24,900.
why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, and the RBI's inflation tolerance band guides its interest rate decisions.
